title: 1979–1993 Ford Mustang 5-Lug Wilwood DynaPro Lug-Mount Front Dynamic Drag Brake Kit
description:
Shave over 30 lbs of unsprung rotating weight off the front of your Fox Body with the Wilwood DynaPro Lug-Mount Front Dynamic Drag Brake Kit (140-14420-D). Designed specifically for 5-lug converted 1979–1993 Mustangs utilizing factory V8 disc brake spindles, this kit combines Wilwood's DynaPro 4-piston calipers with lightweight dynamic-mount rotors built for serious drag strip duty.

The high-tech dynamic rotor mounting setup uses t-nuts to allow thermal expansion, drastically reducing heat distortion and warping under heavy drag strip braking cycles. Paired with Type III hard-anodized forged billet calipers and 1/2"-20 wheel studs, this setup is engineered to drop elapsed times while providing dependable stopping power at the end of the track.

#### What’s Included:

* DynaPro Lug-Mount 4-Piston Calipers: Forged billet aluminum calipers with stainless steel pistons, finished in a Type III hard-anodized gray coating.
* 10.75" x 0.35" Drilled Rotors: Dynamic floating steel rotors engineered to handle thermal stress without warping.
* Billet Aluminum 5-Lug Hubs: Pre-drilled for 5x4.5" and 5x4.75" wheel bolt patterns with heavy-duty 1/2"-20 lug studs installed.
* BP-20 Smart Pads & Hardware: BP-20 medium-friction brake pads, wheel bearings, grease seals, dust caps, and mounting hardware.

#### Key Specs & Application Notes:

* Weight Savings: Saves 30+ lbs compared to stock 5-lug disc configurations.
* Vehicle Weight Limits: Rated for 4-wheel disc vehicles up to 2,800 lbs, or rear-drum equipped vehicles up to 2,400 lbs.
* Wheel Clearance: Fits most popular 15" drag wheels (Track width increases +0.49" per side over stock OE hub offset).
* Brake Lines Required: Flexlines are not included. Wilwood requires stainless flexlines with -3AN fittings (Wilwood P/N 220-6471) to route to chassis hard lines.

#### Vehicle Fitment:

* 1979–1993 Ford Mustang (5-Lug converted models using 1987–1993 V8 factory disc brake spindles)
* *Note: Requires minor spindle modification for installation. Check wheel clearance diagrams prior to mounting.*
